messages:
pagerbot: PAGER — sustained 429 spike on /v1/embeddings in prod-us-east. current window 12m, error_rate=6.8%, p95 latency up. alert_id=EMB-429-197650. paging @eng-sre on-call :rotating_light:
Alex R: saw it, joining. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/embeddings/429-503-overview (short link)
Alex R: quick glance — spikes line up with a big uptick in batch size from a few tenants, also a tiny deployment at 00:45UTC but rollout was flagged ok.
Josh P: query I ran to get top offenders:
```
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as reqs, sum(case when status=429 then 1 else 0 end) as errs
FROM requests
WHERE path LIKE '/v1/embeddings%'
  AND ts > now()-interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY errs DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
results: t-192 (38% of 429s), t-501 (21%), t-401 (7%)
Maria L: proposed mitigations — short list:
- enable adaptive global rate limiter to take pressure off serving (drops best-effort clients)
- apply temporary per-tenant hard caps for top noisy tenants
- disable batch-embeddings-v2 feature flag (it's creating huge batched requests)
- route to smaller/quantized embedding model as fallback for non-enterprise tenants
Sam T: +1 to per-tenant caps first. disabling FF is higher blast radius but effective. i'd rather try caps + model fallback before killing feature globally.
Alex R: actionable commands i've used in staging and ready for prod (copy/paste):
```
# set global adaptive limiter target
infractl ratelimit set --env prod --policy adaptive --target-error-rate 0.02

# per-tenant cap (hard qps)
authctl tenant update --tenant-id t-192 --max-qps 8
authctl tenant update --tenant-id t-501 --max-qps 12

# toggle feature flag
ffctl toggle prod batch-embeddings-v2 off --who "eng-sre/mitigation"

# route fallback to smaller model
modelctl route --env prod --from embeddings-model-large --to embeddings-model-small-qa --filter "tenant not in (t-enterprise-*)"
```

Alex R: i'm going to apply per-tenant caps for t-192 and t-501 now, monitor 5m. will not toggle FF unless we see no improvement in 8 minutes.
deploy-bot: deploy job 8791 started: apply tenant caps (infractl) — logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/8791
deploy-bot: deploy job 8791 succeeded in 23s.
Alex R: caps live. immediate drop in 429 rate from 6.8% -> 3.1% in the next scrape. p95 latency down ~120ms.
Maria L: good. I'm going to run a quick canary route to embeddings-model-small for 10% of traffic to see quality/cost impact.
Josh P: meanwhile i'm pulling per-tenant request traces for t-192 to confirm client behavior. looks like long-lived streaming calls with huge payloads — probably a batching bug on their side. I DM'd solutions to the tenant owner we have on file (customer id t-192).
CS Ops: thanks — we've started proactive outreach to the two heaviest tenants, CS will ask them to throttle batch sizes on their side. we'll include a suggested mitigation plan and ETA.
Sam T: monitoring panels to watch (shortcuts):
- 429 trend (1m/5m), 503 trend (1m/5m)
- per-tenant qps and error-rate heatmap
- p95/p99 latency panels
- model routing fallback counters
link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/embeddings/429-503-overview
Alex R: also watching the admission queue and backend queue length. If we see queue backs > 5000 we should consider reverting the 00:45 deploy (low confidence) and enabling the emergency token-brake for free-tier clients.
Maria L: update — after caps + 10% fallback routing, 429 down to 1.7% over 10m window, 503 stable. suggest: keep caps for 30m, escalate to disabling feature flag if it creeps back above 3%.
Alex R: ✅ agree. I'll keep the caps and not toggle FF yet.
Sam T: logging note — adding short lived sampling to traces for embeddings endpoint to capture full payload shapes. will flip sampling on for 5m.
Josh P: found repeated client pattern from t-501 where they retried aggressively on 429 which amplified the effect. CS put in outreach + suggested backoff.
deploy-bot: ffctl toggle request queued; no action taken (waiting manual).
Alex R: i've posted a short incident summary in #incidents and added runbook tags. tagging oncall rotation for a handoff in 20m.
Maria L: taking over 02:15UTC handoff. I'll keep an eye for 30m and then escalate to on-call lead if it reappears. leaving notes:
- per-tenant caps: t-192=8qps, t-501=12qps (kept)
- 10% model fallback active
- feature flag still ON (not toggled)
- CS outreach in progress
Sam T: thx — will keep traces and sampling on. please alert if 429 > 3% again or if any enterprise tenant reports degradation.
Alex R: done for now, leaving to Maria. :thumbsup:
Maria L: acknowledged. I'll post a follow-up at +30m with metrics snapshot.
pagerbot: INCIDENT NOTE: status=mitigated_thresholds_reached, watch-mode=active.
Maria L: 30m update — 429 at 0.9%, 503 steady, no new noisy tenants. keeping caps + fallback for another 30m then plan gradual unwind. CS Ops continuing outreach. I will hand to next oncall at 03:00UTC if stable. :white_check_mark:
